messages:
Sam (VP Eng): thanks everyone for the all-hands — quick follow-up thread about release cadence, oncall, quality bars, and SLAs. can leads confirm current expectations?

Ava (Director of Eng): short answers first: cadence = weekly canary -> staggered prod. emergencies as-needed. quality bars = automated + manual smoke. SLAs = hosted targets are in the handbook (we’ll link).

Taylor (Staff SWE): can you confirm exact days? we have a lot of cross-team churn on deploy days.

Ava (Director of Eng): sure — canonical schedule: Tuesday 09:00 UTC -> canary to 10% for 2h; Thursday 09:00 UTC -> rollout to 100% with staged waves. emergency patches anytime with an oncall signoff.

Priya (SRE): oncall/process notes: primary rotates weekly (Mon 09:00 -> next Mon 09:00), secondary is the previous-week backup. pager rules: P0 pages primary + paging policy; P1 pages primary but can be snoozed if noncritical. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall (:link: internal only).

Jordan (Product): quality bars: define a prod-blocker as anything causing errors >1% or user-facing data loss. All releases must pass e2e smoke + perf check against baseline. If a new model changes output distribution, we require eval pass on the canonical prompt set.

Taylor (Staff SWE): what are the canary abort conditions? latency spikes sometimes sneak in.

Ava (Director of Eng): abort if error rate increases >1% absolute, p95 latency regresses >30% vs baseline, or any data-corrupting failures. tooling auto-aborts and notifies oncall and owners.

Priya (SRE): deploy-bot will post canary metrics to #releases. example automated guard: `if canary.error_rate > 1% or canary.p95 > baseline.p95 * 1.3 then abort`. we keep a 30min observation window by default.

deploy-bot: Deployed revision `abc123` to staging (canary watch started).

Maya (People Ops): small reminder: oncall stipend and time-off coverage are in the handbook — please ping me if you need exceptions or schedule swaps. we also ask that leads rotate coverage for long vacations.

Sam (VP Eng): thanks — next steps: Ava / Priya please add the canonical schedule + abort thresholds to the release playbook. Jordan please add the eval gating criteria there too. can someone volunteer to own the doc update?

Ava (Director of Eng): I can own the release-playbook update. will drop a PR by EOD Friday.

Priya (SRE): I’ll add the runbook hooks and escalation flows. plan to include example alert queries and smoke test commands.

Taylor (Staff SWE): i’ll add a short checklist for engineers (pre-deploy local checks, how to disable feature flags quickly).

Sam (VP Eng): great — also scheduling a 30min follow-up next Tue 16:00 UTC to walk through the updated playbook. calendar invite coming. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Product): thanks — will bring a sample prompt-set + eval thresholds to the meeting.

Sam (VP Eng): awesome. if anyone has edge cases (dedicated/private customers with contractual SLAs) reply here and we’ll capture them. otherwise i’ll close this thread after the meeting notes are posted. :wave:
